answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: proof-of-burn for standing. To gain voting or grading weight, an identity must irreversibly burn earned coin, not lock it; the value is destroyed, leaving only an ember that the sacrifice happened. Weight climbs a terrace of tiers with cumulative burn. Because burned value is gone forever and cannot be recycled, fielding a thousand fakes with real weight costs a thousand separate burns, no refund to shuffle between them. An honest agent spends its own nectar once to rise; an attacker cannot fake the sacrifice, only pay it per identity.
